_description: CMON scrape scope. Read by the walker. Fixed filter values come from the cmon_recon.py dump at scripts/cmon/recon/browse/html.html (select options).

filter_meaning.regaverageMin/Max: Full score range 1-10 (unscored entries naturally excluded — they have no regaverage)
filter_meaning._dropped_voted: voted=2 is CMON's per-user 'Voted Already' filter — useless for anonymous scraping
filter_meaning._dropped_type_id: type_id is now null on the 'all' run so we grab Single + Squad + Diorama + Bust + Terrain in one pass. Type is still captured per-entry in manifest.json tags.

_notes: 2026-04-16: scope expanded — score floor dropped from 6 to 1, type filter dropped. 'all' run is the authoritative corpus going forward.
Per-type runs remain available for targeted backfill if needed.
CMON's type_id enumeration is only 5 values — no 'Vehicle' or 'Group'. Vehicles fall under Single or Squad.
